channel_stats._interpretation: Stats are calculated from the candidate image after an unverified source-channel mapping; labels remain blocked.

mrao_candidate.channel_contract: Candidate only: R=Metallic(0), G=CandidateAO, B=CandidateSmoothness, A=Emission(0). Source G/B labels are unverified.
mrao_candidate.preview_alpha_handling: Candidate alpha remains data; preview files ignore alpha for visible RGB inspection.

consequences.low: Uses low-res (512px) texture mips, basic ambient occlusion, and disabled specular details to protect memory. The visual quality is kept at the absolute minimum acceptable standard.
consequences.middle: Uses standard resolution (1024px) texture mips with full AO and smoothness channel rendering. Normal maps provide standard depth breakup.
consequences.high: Uses full resolution (2048px/1024px depending on asset category) with enhanced normal map detail and full specular breakup, increasing terrain realism.
consequences.ultra: Sensory overkill. Uses maximum texture mip levels, advanced micro-variation shaders, and extra near-field normal/specular detail mapping without changing authority routes.

channel_semantics_blocker: Candidate PNGs exist for inspection only. Promotion requires an explicit shader target plus material layout proof: repack to production ARM and serialize the target layout, or target a shader/material that decodes MRAO.
source_channel_contract_risk: Batch31 source maps are MRAO-style candidates. Production _MaskMap is ARM R=AO/G=Roughness/B=Metallic; Hecton_Master_Lit requires serialized _MasterShadowParams.w=3 for ARM, or w=0 only if the material deliberately targets true MRAO.
required_owner_decision: Choose shader target and serialized mask layout. For Hecton_Master_Lit, prove _MasterShadowParams.w=3 for ARM or w=0 for true MRAO before Unity import.
mrao_preview_note: MRAO Candidate PNG alpha is candidate data only. RGB inspection previews ignore alpha so visible channels can be inspected; alpha must not be advertised as universal shader alpha proof.
